quest.title: Adventurer Exam: Taking Flight
quest.description: Anna from Mondstadt would really like to become an adventurer...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Hmm... I think I've more or less got it all down now! But I won't get anywhere just by listening...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you give me a demonstration of wind glider usage?

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: I sure will! Let's get going, then!

talks.objective: Demonstrate how to use a wind glider to Anna

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One person per glider.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Hmm, I see...

talks.objective: Demonstrate how to use a wind glider to Anna

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That depends on how good the person doing the gliding is.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Huh, is that so...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Wow, you're really good at this! No wonder Amber said that I could learn a thing or two from you.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Hehe, with you as my coach, this exam will be a cinch!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Thanks so much! Here, these are for you. I'm off to revise some more!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I wonder what color my wind glider should be...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Blue? Green? Maybe a bit of both, perhaps?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Second question: what should we take note of when using wind gliders?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: To select appropriate take-off points and to assume the correct take-off posture.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Okay, interesting...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, why do we need stuff like a wind glider license?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Did you take the license exam, Anthony?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I don't use wind gliders, so I've never taken the exam...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want to take the gliding exam, Anna?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Yup. It's something that all adventurers need to use, so I've been looking to practice!

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: But I never thought that there was such a thing as a gliding license...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I mean, I've already signed up to take part, but I don't think I have all the knowledge down pat just yet...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler, I heard Amber mention that you've got a license already. Could you help me revise for the exam?

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Well, no, but I just met her during the signup process.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: She mentioned you while explaining the exam process to me. She said you did really well!

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: So I got to thinking that I could consult you about some of the exam questions...

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: Okay, so, I have three questions for you.

response.speaker: Anna
response.text: So... First off, how many people can a single wind glider carry while airborne?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That depends on the weight of the person gliding.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I see, I see...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Taking off using Anemo Slimes is always an interesting option.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Is this so? Huh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You need to make sure that you're below the wind glider.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Hmm, I see...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Here's my third question, then: what should we take note of when landing?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Select an appropriate landing spot, and do not fold your wind glider in abruptly.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Alright, I see...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You have to mind your descent posture most of all.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Huh. Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Make sure to find solid ground to land on.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Ah, is that so...
